letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my cutie,

Every sunrise—whether it’s the golden dunes of Dubai or the gentle breezes over Ahmedabad—reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful world with you. As the calendar turns to late spring, I find myself counting the moments until we’re together again, laughing over chai and camel rides alike. Your smile lights up my days, your love steadies my heart, and every “I love you” feels like a fresh promise. Thank you for being my forever adventure.

All my love,
Tirth
poem:
In desert heat or monsoon rain,  
Your laughter is my sweetest refrain.  
Across the miles, my heart’s true beat,  
With you, my love, life’s song is complete.
